- Plenty of Fruits & Vegetables
- Whole Grains
- Lean Protein
- Healthy Fats
- Increased Caloric Intake
- Increased Iron
- Increased Folic Acid, Increased Calcium

Foods/Ingredients to Restrict or Avoid:
- High Mercury Fish (shark, swordfish, king mackerel, bigeye tuna)
- Raw/Undercooked Seafood (sushi, sashimi, raw oysters)
- Uncooked Refrigerated Smoked Seafood
- Undercooked Meat/Poultry/Eggs
- Pates/Meat Spreads (refrigerated)
- Unpasteurized Dairy/Juice
- Raw Sprouts
- Excessive Caffeine (>200mg/day)
- Alcohol
- Certain Herbal Teas
- Liver/Liver Products (due to high Vitamin A)
